theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      
      have h2 : 2^(ℓ - i) = 2^(ℓ - (i + 1)) * 2 := by
        conv_rhs => enter[2]; rw [←Nat.pow_one 2]
        rw [←pow_add]; congr
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega)]
        -- ⊢ ℓ - ↑i = ℓ - (↑i + 1 - 1)
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := 1)]
      omega
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1)) (i := 1)
      · omega
      · omega
    ⟩)
  have h_eval_qMap_x₀ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₀.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₀
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₀) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
    -- exact qMap_eval_fiber_eq_self ⟦L⟧ ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ (by simp only; omega) h_i_succ_lt y 0
  have h_eval_qMap_x₁ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₁.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₁
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₁) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have hx₀ := qMap_total_fiber_basis_sum_repr 𝔽q β i (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) y 0
  have hx₁ := qMap_total_fiber_basis_sum_repr 𝔽q β i (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) y 1
  simp only [Fin.isValue] at hx₀ hx₁

  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    simp only [Fin.isValue, x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [hx₁, hx₀]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finset_sum, SetLike.val_smul]
    have h_index : ℓ + 𝓡 - i = (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    rw! (castMode := .all) [h_index]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ] -- (free_term + y_repr) - (free_term + y_repr) = 1
    -- First, simplify the free terms
    simp only [fiber_coeff, eqRec_eq_cast, lt_one_iff, reducePow, Fin.isValue,
      Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, mod_succ, dite_smul, ite_smul, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_mod]
    have h_cast_0 :
        (cast (Eq.symm h_index ▸ rfl : Fin (ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + 1) + 1) = Fin (ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i)) 0).val =
        0 := by
      rw [←Fin.cast_eq_cast (h := by omega)]
      rw [Fin.cast_val_eq_val (h_eq := by omega)]
      simp only [Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, mod_succ_eq_iff_lt]
      omega
    
    simp only [h_cast_0, ↓reduceDIte]
    have h_getBit_0_of_0 : Nat.getBit (k := 0) (n := 0) = 0 := by
      decide
    have h_getBit_0_of_1 : Nat.getBit (k := 0) (n := 1) = 1 := by
      decide
    simp only [h_getBit_0_of_1, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, h_getBit_0_of_0, zero_add]
    rw! (castMode := .all) [←h_index]
    
    simp only [get_sDomain_basis, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, zero_mod, add_zero, cast_eq]
    rw [normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1 𝔽q β]
    ring_nf
    conv_rhs => rw [←add_zero (a := 1)]
    rw [add_sub_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [sub_eq_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_congr (h := by rfl)
    simp only [mem_univ, congr_eqRec, Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, and_false,
      ↓reduceDIte, add_tsub_cancel_right, Fin.eta, imp_self, implies_true]
  set P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  -- Set up the even and odd refinement polynomials
  set P₀_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) => coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
    have h1 : ℓ - (i + 1) + 1 = ℓ - i := by omega
    have h2 : 2^(ℓ - (i + 1) + 1) = 2^(ℓ - i) := by rw [h1]
    
    rw []; omega⟩
  set P₁_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) => coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
    have h1 : ℓ - (i + 1) + 1 = ℓ - i := by omega
    have h2 : 2^(ℓ - (i + 1) + 1) = 2^(ℓ - i) := by rw [h1]
    
    rw []; omega⟩
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  -- Equation 39 : P^(i)(X) = P₀^(i+1)(q^(i)(X)) + X · P₁^(i+1)(q^(i)(X))
  have h_equation_39_x₀ : P_i.eval x₀.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₀, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_equation_39_x₁ : P_i.eval x₁.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₁, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  set f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) => P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  -- Unfold the definition of f_i_plus_1 using the fold function
  
  -- Main calculation following the outline
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by dsimp
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      rw [h_equation_39_x₀, h_equation_39_x₁]
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal + r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) +
        P₁.eval y.val * (x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val)) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x₁.val - x₀.val)) +
        P₁.eval y.val * ((x₁.val - x₀.val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [h_fiber_diff]; ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      -- ⊢ eval y (C (1-r) * ∑...) + eval y (C r * ∑...) = eval y (∑...)
      rw [←Polynomial.eval_add]
      -- ⊢ poly_left.eval y = poly_right.eval y
      congr
      simp_rw [mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      -- We now prove that the terms inside the sums are equal for each index.
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have h_j_lt : j.val < 2 ^ (ℓ - (↑i + 1)) := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq]
        omega
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
        rw []
        apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
          (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)⟩)), ←mul_assoc,
        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal))]; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
        apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
          (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)⟩)), ←mul_assoc,
        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C r_chal)]; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv_rhs => rw [mul_comm]
      rw [←mul_add]
      congr
      simp only [←Polynomial.C_mul, ←Polynomial.C_add]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have h_iR : ↑i < ℓ + 𝓡 := fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i
    have hb : ((sDomain_basis 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, Nat.lt_trans h_iR h_ℓ_add_R_rate⟩ h_iR)
        ⟨0, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h_iR⟩ : L) = 1 :=
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate _ h_iR
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb]
    ring
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
    ring
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      simp only [f_i, h_eval x₀ 0 rfl, h_eval x₁ 1 rfl]
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [show x₁.val = x₀.val + 1 from by rw [← h_diff, add_comm, sub_add_cancel]]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      rw [← h_poly]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)

  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)

    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs

    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y

  set x₁ := fiberMap 1

    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := by simp [Fin2ToF2]

      rw [← h_poly]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by

      oddRefinement]

    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
    ring
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      simp only [f_i, h_eval x₀ 0 rfl, h_eval x₁ 1 rfl]
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [show x₁.val = x₀.val + 1 from by rw [← h_diff, add_comm, sub_add_cancel]]
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]

    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)

      rw [show x₁.val = x₀.val + 1 from by rw [← h_diff, add_comm, sub_add_cancel]]
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = x₀.val + 1 := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, add_comm, hb]
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    ring
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
      = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
        simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i, h_eval x₀ 0 rfl, h_eval x₁ 1 rfl]
      _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
        rw [h_add]
        ring
      _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
        rw [← h_poly]
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)

      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    ring
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      simp only [f_i, h_eval x₀ 0 rfl, h_eval x₁ 1 rfl]
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [h_add]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      rw [← h_poly]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
      = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +

        simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval x₀ 0 rfl, h_eval x₁ 1 rfl]

        rw [h_add]
        ring
      _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
        rw [← h_poly]
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) (k : Fin 2) (hx : x = fiberMap k) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    subst hx
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
      = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
        simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval x₀ 0 rfl, h_eval x₁ 1 rfl]
      _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
        rw [h_add]
        ring
      _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
        rw [← h_poly]
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
      = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
        simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1]
      _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
        rw [h_add, ← h_poly]
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
        ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    dsimp only [x₀, x₁, fiberMap]
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁, zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
      = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
        simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1]
      _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
        rw [h_add, ← h_poly]
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
        ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have e₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, e₀, e₁,
      zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs

    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]

    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl

    have e₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1

    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]

    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y

    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
  have h_add : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1, zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq k]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, x₀, x₁, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_add : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1, zero_add, hb]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring

  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs

    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y

    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl

    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, zero_add, hb,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y]

      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_add : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    have fz : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 ∧ Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz.1, fz.2, zero_smul, one_smul, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, zero_add, hb,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_add : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, zero_add, hb,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fiberMap k) y
      ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k),
      evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_add : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, zero_add, hb,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fiberMap k) y
      ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k),
      evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_add : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    have fz0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have fz1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    have hb := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i)
    simp only [fz0, fz1, zero_smul, one_smul, fiberMap, Submodule.coe_add, zero_add, hb,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y]
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fiberMap k) y
      ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k),
      evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs, f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  have h_poly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement,
      oddRefinement, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    rfl
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, fiberMap, h_eval 0, h_eval 1, h_add, ← h_poly,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring
